title: Folly. Persist.
html_source:
The fool who persists in his folly will become wise.

— William Blake, Proverbs of Hell.

This line was known to Joyce. In fact Harold Bloom, in James Joyce (page 64), assures us that Joyce ‘quoted Blake’s dictum’ during attempts to publish his writings in America.
